title: Everyday Phrases — Teaching Parents Technology
scene_zh: 教父母用科技 · 情境對話
title_quote: Mom, this box is for you.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】👨‍👩‍👧 實用教父母用科技必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Teaching Parents Technology
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的教父母用科技情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從新手機連Wi-Fi、調大字型、學視訊通話與語音訊息，到手機付款、掛號、叫車與防詐提醒，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Teaching Parents Technology phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue) — a patient son walks his mother through a new phone, home Wi-Fi, bigger text, video calls, voice messages, mobile payment, clinic booking, ride calls and scam warnings. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mom, this box is for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For me? What is inside?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A new phone, your old one broke.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə nu foʊn, jɔr oʊld wʌn broʊk./
dialogue.zh: 一支新手機，你的舊那支壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But I liked that little one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It served you ten good years.
dialogue.zh: 它已經好好陪你十年了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now it takes a whole day to open.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt teɪks ə hoʊl deɪ tə ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 現在開個頁面要一整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So let's make this one yours.
dialogue.zh: 所以我們把這支變成你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll set it all up for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /jul sɛt ɪt ɔl ʌp fər mi?/
dialogue.zh: 你要全部幫我設定好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll teach you, not just do it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl titʃ ju, nɑt dʒʌst du ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我不只做給你看，我要教你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is harder, dear boy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not today, we have all night.
dialogue.zh: 今天不趕，我們有一整晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All night? I'm tired already.
dialogue.zh: 一整晚？我已經有點累了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, then tea time.
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘就好，然後我們喝茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can do twenty minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, let's charge it fully.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How long does a full charge take?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ dʌz ə fʊl tʃɑrdʒ teɪk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: About one hour, no rushing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then sit, I'll pour the tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cable came along in the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkeɪbəl keɪm əˈlɔŋ ɪn ðə bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 充電線一併放在盒子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is, so thin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The small end goes at the bottom.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɔl ɛnd ɡoʊz æt ðə ˈbɑtəm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gently, right? No pushing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It clicks when it's in.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now a tiny bolt appeared!
dialogue.zh: 現在出現一個小閃電了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That means power is coming in.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What number shows on the screen?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty percent, it will climb.
dialogue.zh: 百分之二十，還會往上升。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like water filling a cup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You explain it better than I do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɪkˈspleɪn ɪt ˈbɛtər ðæn aɪ du./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I only remember old things.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press this side button once.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The screen woke up so fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now slide your finger up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like opening a curtain?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, exactly like that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It asks me for a password.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four numbers you choose yourself.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: May I use your birthday?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please pick something else.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our old house number, then.
dialogue.zh: 那就用我們舊家的門牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Enter it again, just to be sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛntər ɪt əˈɡɛn, dʒʌst tə bi ʃʊr./
dialogue.zh: 再輸入一次，確定沒打錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, it is locked in.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That lock keeps you safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So no one else can look?
dialogue.zh: 那別人就看不到裡面對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only you, that's the point.
dialogue.zh: 只有你可以，重點就在這。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I like that, very private.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's find the home Wi-Fi.
dialogue.zh: 我們來找家裡的無線網路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that the internet without wires?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it's already in the air.
dialogue.zh: 對，它本來就飄在空氣裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then why do I need a code?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn waɪ du aɪ nid ə koʊd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So neighbors don't use yours.
dialogue.zh: 這樣鄰居就不會用到你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, a gate on our road.
dialogue.zh: 噢，就像我們家門口的柵欄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open the gear, the settings.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The wheel that looks like a clock?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wil ðæt lʊks laɪk ə klɑk?/
dialogue.zh: 那個看起來像鐘表的圓盤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the one, tap it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So many words in this page.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wi-Fi is the first line.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see our living room name.
dialogue.zh: 我看到我們客廳那個名字了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap it and type the password.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's on the fridge note.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the one I wrote last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə wʌn aɪ roʊt læst mʌnθ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Capital letters or small ones?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The first one is capital.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done! It says connected.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You did that all by yourself.
dialogue.zh: 那全部都是你自己做到的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You only told me where to look.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈoʊnli toʊld mi wɛr tə lʊk./
dialogue.zh: 你只是告訴我該看哪裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the letters are too small.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they hurt my eyes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Settings, then display and text.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Display means the screen here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡的顯示是指螢幕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and the third line.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A thin bar with a circle.
dialogue.zh: 一條細線上有一個圓圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Drag the circle to the right.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh! Everything grew bigger.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stop when it feels easy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, this size is kind.
dialogue.zh: 這個大小剛剛好，很溫柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That size is perfect, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can read my own messages.
dialogue.zh: 我自己傳的訊息我都看得懂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's make the screen softer.
dialogue.zh: 我們把螢幕調柔和一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At night, yes, please do.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This slider is the brightness.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Down is dim, up is bright.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Halfway is good for sleeping.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My eyes thank you, son.
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛要謝謝你了，孩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the sound, press this key.
dialogue.zh: 接下來是聲音，按這個鍵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Up is louder, down is quiet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Test it, I'll call your phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, it's ringing in my hand!
dialogue.zh: 噢，它在我手上響起來了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I set that piano ringtone for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɛt ðæt piˈænoʊ ˈrɪŋˌtoʊn fər ju./
dialogue.zh: 那個鋼琴鈴聲是我幫妳設的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How did you know I liked it?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dɪd ju noʊ aɪ laɪkt ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You hum it while cooking, Mom.
dialogue.zh: 你做飯時一直哼這首啊，媽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So it stays, I love that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's set a photo as wallpaper.
dialogue.zh: 我們把一張照片設成桌布。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The family picture at the lake?
dialogue.zh: 那張湖邊的全家福好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open the gallery, the flower icon.
dialogue.zh: 打開相簿，那個花朵圖示。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flowers keep my photos?
dialogue.zh: 花朵圖示放著我的照片？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, every picture you took.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So many, like an album.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pick it, then hold the screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A menu came up, set wallpaper!
dialogue.zh: 跳出一個選單，設為桌布！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the way, the tea is ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə weɪ, ðə ti ɪz ˈrɛdi./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more minute, my knees hurt.
dialogue.zh: 再一分鐘，我的膝蓋有點痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit, I'll bring the cup to you.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt, aɪl brɪŋ ðə kʌp tə ju./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You spoil an old woman, dear.
dialogue.zh: 你這樣寵一個老太婆了，乖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight's lesson: seeing Linda.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My sister? Across the whole sea?
dialogue.zh: 我姊姊？隔著整片海的那個？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, her face on this screen.
dialogue.zh: 對，她的臉就在這螢幕上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was magic when I was young.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌz ˈmædʒɪk wɛn aɪ wʌz jʌŋ./
dialogue.zh: 在我年輕的時候那像仙術。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need one small app for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi nid wʌn smɔl æp fər ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我們只要一個小的應用程式。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small is good, I trust small.
dialogue.zh: 小的好，小的東西我才信得過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open the store, the blue bag.
dialogue.zh: 打開商店，藍色袋子那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A shop that carries no bags?
dialogue.zh: 一家不用提袋的商店嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It sells only invisible things.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then how do I pay for it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn haʊ du aɪ peɪ fər ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one is free, just tap get.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn ɪz fri, dʒʌst tæp ɡɛt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free and still inside the shop?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap, then wait for the circle.
dialogue.zh: 點一下，然後等那個圓圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It turns and turns, like a fan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt tɜrnz ænd tɜrnz, laɪk ə fæn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That means it's arriving now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Arriving? Where is the box then?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No box, it lands on the page.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ bɑks, ɪt lændz ɑn ðə peɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 沒有箱子，它落在頁面上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There it is, a green camera!
dialogue.zh: 在那裡，一個綠色的相機！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open it, we must sign in.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sign in, like a hotel desk?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost, but with your number.
dialogue.zh: 差不多，不過是用你的號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My new number, the one today?
dialogue.zh: 我的新號碼，今天剛有的那個？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Type it slow, I'll read with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪp ɪt sloʊ, aɪl rid wɪð ju./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten digits, and I finished.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now a code comes by message.
dialogue.zh: 現在會有一組碼傳進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It came already, six little numbers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never show that code to others.
dialogue.zh: 那組碼不要給任何人看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even your father must wait?
dialogue.zh: 連你爸爸也不能知道嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Especially him, he loves jokes.
dialogue.zh: 尤其是他，他最愛開玩笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Typed! Now it says welcome.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are inside, look around.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So many buttons, I feel shy.
dialogue.zh: 這麼多按鈕，我有點怕怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only one button tonight, promise.
dialogue.zh: 今晚只學一顆按鈕，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I can sleep tonight too.
dialogue.zh: 那我今晚也睡得安心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add Linda first, tap the plus.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small cross with four arms?
dialogue.zh: 那個伸出四條線的小十字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her name, then her phone number.
dialogue.zh: 她的名字，接著她的手機號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still, I know it by heart.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, her photo came up.
dialogue.zh: 有了，她的照片跳出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From our lake trip, look at us!
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌm aʊr leɪk trɪp, lʊk æt ʌs!/
dialogue.zh: 是我們去湖邊那次的，看我們！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap her name, then the camera.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that calling her, right now?
dialogue.zh: 這樣就是在打給她了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It rings, and we wait a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt rɪŋz, ænd wi weɪt ə bɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My heart is beating, can you hear?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hɑrt ɪz ˈbitɪŋ, kæn ju hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我的心在跳，你聽得見嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She picked up! Look, her face.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh! She looks so close, so real.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ! ʃi lʊks soʊ kloʊs, soʊ ril./
dialogue.zh: 噢！她好近，像真的在眼前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say hello, keep the phone still.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Linda! It's me, your little sister.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She heard you, she is laughing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why is my face so wide here?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz maɪ feɪs soʊ waɪd hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼我在這裡臉這麼寬？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The camera stretches near things.
dialogue.zh: 鏡頭會把很近的東西拉寬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I'll lean back a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, now you look natural.
dialogue.zh: 對了，這樣看起來就自然了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She says my kitchen looks bright.
dialogue.zh: 她說我的廚房看起來好亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask her to see the roses.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Toward the window, like this?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Move slowly, the picture follows.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, it went all fuzzy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, it finds focus again.
dialogue.zh: 等一下，它會重新對好焦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There! She sees every bud now.
dialogue.zh: 好了！她每個花苞都看見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She wants a photo of them.
dialogue.zh: 她要一張那些花的照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I snap while we are talking?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ snæp waɪl wi ɑr ˈtɔkɪŋ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, tap the white round button.
dialogue.zh: 可以，按那個白色圓圓的鍵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Click! It made a real sound.
dialogue.zh: 喀嚓！它真的發出聲音了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now send it in this chat.
dialogue.zh: 現在把照片傳到這個對話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where? I only see my own words.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr? aɪ ˈoʊnli si maɪ oʊn wɜrdz./
dialogue.zh: 在哪裡？我只看到我打的字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See the small picture corner?
dialogue.zh: 看到那個小小圖案的角落嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it shows my rose already!
dialogue.zh: 有，它已經顯示我的薔薇了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap the paper plane to send.
dialogue.zh: 點紙飛機圖示就送出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It flew! It is gone from my hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt flu! ɪt ɪz ɡɔn frʌm maɪ hænd./
dialogue.zh: 飛走了！它離開我的手了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, she sent one back.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her cat, asleep on the sofa!
dialogue.zh: 她的貓，在沙發上睡著了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now try a voice message.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I speak, and she hears later?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold the microphone button down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold, not tap, like a doorbell.
dialogue.zh: 是按住不是點一下，像門鈴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, now say something warm.
dialogue.zh: 一點不錯，現在說句暖的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Goodnight, sister, dream something sweet.
dialogue.zh: 晚安，姊姊，做個甜甜的夢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let go, and it goes to her.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɡoʊ, ænd ɪt ɡoʊz tə hɜr./
dialogue.zh: 放手，它就走到她那裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My voice inside that little wave.
dialogue.zh: 我的聲音在那個小波形裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap it to hear yourself back.
dialogue.zh: 點一下就能聽回自己的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strange, that voice sounds young.
dialogue.zh: 好奇怪，那個聲音好年輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's you, only clearer.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll keep this trick for tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 這一招我留到明天再用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's end the call softly.
dialogue.zh: 我們輕輕地把電話掛了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wave first, then which button?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The red phone, one small tap.
dialogue.zh: 紅色的電話圖示，輕輕一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The screen went calm again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did that feel, honestly?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like opening a door closed for years.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ˈoʊpənɪŋ ə dɔr kloʊzd fər jɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 像打開一關了好多年的門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She'll ring you any day now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And I can answer with one tap?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd aɪ kæn ˈænsər wɪð wʌn tæp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Always, look at the green one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green is answer, red is stop.
dialogue.zh: 綠色是接起來，紅色是停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the whole lesson, done.
dialogue.zh: 這節課就到這裡，完成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One lesson, and I called my sister.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈlɛsən, ænd aɪ kɔld maɪ ˈsɪstər./
dialogue.zh: 一堂課，我就打通給我姊姊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But tonight has one more part.
dialogue.zh: 不過今晚還有一個部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Something like money and doctors?
dialogue.zh: 像是金錢和醫生那一種嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both, and a ride downtown.
dialogue.zh: 兩樣都學，還有去市區的車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A ride? From this phone?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, let's add your card.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My bank card, the green one?
dialogue.zh: 我的銀行卡，綠色那張嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Type just the last group of four.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪp dʒʌst ðə læst ɡrup ʌv fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 只要輸入最後那組四碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only four, why not all of them?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli fɔr, waɪ nɑt ɔl ʌv ðɛm?/
dialogue.zh: 只要四碼，為什麼不要全部？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That keeps your card hidden.
dialogue.zh: 這樣你的卡號就藏好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clever, like a small secret.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bank will send a code.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The same rule: I tell nobody.
dialogue.zh: 同樣的規矩：我不告訴任何人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, it says card added.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now my wallet can rest.
dialogue.zh: 現在我的錢包可以休息了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At the store, we'll try it.
dialogue.zh: 到商店時我們就試一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In front of the whole line?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody sees, I'll stand back.
dialogue.zh: 沒人會看見，我站遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I can breathe, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open the pay page here, see the square.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ðə peɪ peɪdʒ hɪr, si ðə skwɛr./
dialogue.zh: 打開付款頁，就在這裡，看到那個方框。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one that looks like a maze?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wʌn ðæt lʊks laɪk ə meɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 那個看起來像迷宮的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, that's a QR code.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A maze I can walk through?
dialogue.zh: 一個我能走過去的迷宮？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Point your camera at it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Far away or very near?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: About a hand's length away.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It beeped! Our shop heard it!
dialogue.zh: 它嗶了一聲！我們家的小店聽見了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now type the amount, milk.
dialogue.zh: 現在輸入金額，牛奶的錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two fifty, or two hundred?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at the price on the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðə praɪs ɑn ðə bɑks./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same number, so I type it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press confirm, then wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A green check! Am I done?
dialogue.zh: 出現綠色的勾了！我付完了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paid in full, no cash left.
dialogue.zh: 付清了，一塊錢現金都沒花。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I feel like a young shopper.
dialogue.zh: 我覺得自己像個年輕買家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep the receipt picture, too.
dialogue.zh: 也把收據的照片留下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where is that stored, then?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In your email, search it later.
dialogue.zh: 在你的信箱裡，之後搜尋就有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everything keeps a paper trail.
dialogue.zh: 每件事都留下一條紙的痕跡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the hospital app.
dialogue.zh: 接著是醫院的應用程式。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For my aching shoulder?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can book a visit there.
dialogue.zh: 你可以在上面預約看診。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Without the busy phone line?
dialogue.zh: 不用打那條永遠忙線的電話？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open it, tap the first box.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It asks for my birthday now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Year, month, day, in that order.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old habit: I write day first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just tap the little calendar.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, my year is chosen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pick the doctor you know.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dr. Wu? She is very kind.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Choose a time on Monday.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine, before the crowd comes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the green book button.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says booked, with my name!
dialogue.zh: 它寫著已預約，還有我的名字！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show that screen at the desk.
dialogue.zh: 在櫃台把那個畫面給他們看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No forms, no pen, nothing.
dialogue.zh: 不用填表，不用筆，什麼都不用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the car to get there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can it come to our street?
dialogue.zh: 它可以開到我們這條街嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Type the hospital name.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The map shows two roads.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The blue one is faster.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It shows the price too, hmm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap request, then it searches.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three minutes away, look!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read the plate before you move.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll match the plate with the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl mætʃ ðə pleɪt wɪð ðə skrin./
dialogue.zh: 我會把車牌和螢幕核對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, never guess, always check.
dialogue.zh: 很好，不要猜，一定要核對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You worry like my mother.
dialogue.zh: 你擔憂的樣子像我母親。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, the serious warning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You sat down, so it's big.
dialogue.zh: 你都坐下來了，一定很要緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Strange links are bait, Mom.
dialogue.zh: 陌生的連結就是魚餌，媽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blue words in messages?
dialogue.zh: 訊息裡那些藍色的字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never open them, not once.
dialogue.zh: 永遠不要點開，一次都不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even if they say free?
dialogue.zh: 就算它寫著免費也不行？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Especially those, nothing is free.
dialogue.zh: 那種更要小心，沒有一件事是白來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A prize I never entered?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, that's how they fish.
dialogue.zh: 一點不錯，他們就是這樣釣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So I'm the fish in the pond?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪm ðə fɪʃ ɪn ðə pɑnd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not anymore, you know now.
dialogue.zh: 從現在起不會了，你已經懂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What if it looks like you?
dialogue.zh: 如果訊息看起來像你怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call me to check, always.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even at midnight, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Midnight is fine, really.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'd rather wake you than pay.
dialogue.zh: 我寧可叫醒你，也不想賠錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never read codes out loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even if that voice is yours?
dialogue.zh: 就算那是你的聲音，也不行嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then a secret word between us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So a fake one will fail.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've got the whole idea.
dialogue.zh: 你已經抓住整個重點了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One rule: I stop and ask.
dialogue.zh: 一條規矩：我先停下來問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's wiser than most people.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people rush, I waited.
dialogue.zh: 多數人急著做，我等了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also, update when it asks.
dialogue.zh: 還有，它請更新時就更新。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those late night pop-ups?
dialogue.zh: 那些半夜跳出來的視窗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, they close small holes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like patching my winter coat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me tomorrow, we'll check.
dialogue.zh: 明天給我看，我們一起檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll bring the card and the list.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl brɪŋ ðə kɑrd ænd ðə lɪst./
dialogue.zh: 我會把卡和清單都帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now close the phone, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's already dark outside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's write steps on small cards.
dialogue.zh: 我們把步驟寫在小卡上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like the recipes in my book?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, one step per card.
dialogue.zh: 一點不錯，一張卡一個步驟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Card one: open the green camera.
dialogue.zh: 第一張：打開綠色的相機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card two: tap her photo.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Card three: wait for ringing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card four: hold and talk.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Card five: let go, it sends.
dialogue.zh: 第五張：放手就傳出去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card six: press the red button.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means the call is over.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six cards, all in one row.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Number them in big letters.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep them beside the charger.
dialogue.zh: 把它們放在充電線旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So I practice while it charges?
dialogue.zh: 那我就可以邊充電邊練習？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect plan, clever lady.
dialogue.zh: 這計畫真好，聰明的女士。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lady, yes, with silver hair.
dialogue.zh: 是呀，一位白頭髮的女士。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now favorites on the first screen.
dialogue.zh: 現在把最常用的放到首頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Favorites means near my thumb?
dialogue.zh: 常用是指靠近我拇指的地方？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, camera, phone, hospital.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three icons, no more, right?
dialogue.zh: 三個圖示，不再多了，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's plenty for one week.
dialogue.zh: 一週來說這樣就很夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will start tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: After breakfast, say nine o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine is good, tea is done.
dialogue.zh: 九點很好，那時候茶也喝完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll do payments that morning.
dialogue.zh: 那個上午我們來練付款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The money part, yes please.
dialogue.zh: 跟錢有關的那一部分，好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And one trick for tonight.
dialogue.zh: 再加一個今晚的小技巧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me, I'm still awake.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add me to your speed dial.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The star means favorite, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press it, then listen for me.
dialogue.zh: 按下它，然後聽我手機會不會響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hello? Oh, it's only me!
dialogue.zh: 喂？噢，是我自己打給自己！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You called yourself, ha ha.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wanted to see it work.
dialogue.zh: 我想看看它到底能不能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It works, loud and clear.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow I'll call your father.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He'll pretend he isn't home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know him better than that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say I taught you everything.
dialogue.zh: 就說是我把一切都教會妳的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My proud boy, I'll say that.
dialogue.zh: 我驕傲的孩子，我會這麼說的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The phone is only a tool.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What matters is you sitting here.
dialogue.zh: 重要的是你坐在我身邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll do it all week, Mom.
dialogue.zh: 這一整週我都會陪你練。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You have your own work, dear.
dialogue.zh: 你自己也有工作要忙啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Work can wait till ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the last lesson?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, now hand me the phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Are you turning it off?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet mode for the night.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So it won't ring in dreams?
dialogue.zh: 那它不會在我做夢時吵我？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, only alarms at seven.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wake me gently, okay?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll leave you the lamp key.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the cards by my pillow?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All six, right where you sleep.
dialogue.zh: 六張全放，就在你睡的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm curious about tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Curiosity is a good teacher.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better than any school book?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better, because it is yours.
dialogue.zh: 更好，因為那是妳自己的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine, at last, that feels good.
dialogue.zh: 終於是我的了，感覺真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's take the last photo together.
dialogue.zh: 我們最後再一起拍一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With my new phone as camera?
dialogue.zh: 用我的新手機當相機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap the white button, like before.
dialogue.zh: 按那個白色的鍵，就像之前那樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ready? Smile! There it went.
dialogue.zh: 好了嗎？笑一個！拍下去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press the plane, it flies to her.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ðə pleɪn, ɪt flaɪz tə hɜr./
dialogue.zh: 按一下紙飛機，照片就飛到她那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then she shows my gift to them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ʃi ʃoʊz maɪ ɡɪft tə ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 那她就把我的禮物拿給大家看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your gift, you earned it.
dialogue.zh: 這是妳的禮物，妳自己學來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grandma will ask how we did it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡrændmɑ wɪl æsk haʊ wi dɪd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 奶奶一定會問我們怎麼辦到的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can teach her next week.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me? A teacher at my age?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You learned in just one night.
dialogue.zh: 妳只用了一晚就學會了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then Sunday I'll start her class.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The house feels warm tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Because we laughed while learning.
dialogue.zh: 因為我們一邊笑一邊學。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your eyes look heavy now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, but my heart is light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl, bʌt maɪ hɑrt ɪz laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 有一點睏，可是心裡很輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to rest, no more screens.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it to bed, like me.
dialogue.zh: 把它也哄上床吧，像我一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cards with it, all safe.
dialogue.zh: 卡片也一起放，都收好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And tomorrow we begin again?
dialogue.zh: 明天我們再重新開始，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine o'clock, right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring my glasses too, please.
dialogue.zh: 也把老花眼鏡帶來，拜託。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They're already on the table.
dialogue.zh: 它們早就擺在桌子上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You think of everything, son.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's what families do.
dialogue.zh: 家人本來就是這樣互相照顧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then goodnight, my patient boy.
dialogue.zh: 那就晚安了，我耐心的孩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep well, Mom.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lamp is off now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your phone is glowing softly.
dialogue.zh: 你的手機發著柔和的光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like a tiny night light.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's exactly what it is.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，它的功用就是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the night feels less alone.
dialogue.zh: 所以夜裡就沒有那麼孤單了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll be in the next room.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And I can reach you with one tap?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd aɪ kæn ritʃ ju wɪð wʌn tæp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any time, day or night.
dialogue.zh: 任何時候，白天或半夜都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the best feature yet.
dialogue.zh: 這才是今晚最棒的功能。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close your eyes now, Mom.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you for the slow teaching.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dream in English tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Goodnight, my dear boy.
